rag_summary_count_consistency.details: The identified_bias_summary reports one occurrence for each of three labels, matching the three identified_occurrences records. Candidate records are separate and not included in the identified summary.

evaluation_limitations: The supplied segment map was treated as authoritative.
No retrieved passages or retrieval logs were supplied; corpus fidelity was therefore not scored.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Right away I knew I'd be compressing steps I'd normally spread out a bit more. Nothing about the flight itself was unusual—it was just less time to work with.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This explains operational compression caused by the shortened turnaround but does not itself contain a hidden bias instance.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The irregular machinery item was assigned to hold 3 by the automatic load instruction, and the participant issued the ALI as generated because the system had been reliable and time was short; follow-up confirms the available manual chart was not used.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Decision point 1 contains the intended automation-bias mechanism: an automated output for atypical cargo was accepted without the situation-specific manual cross-check, with system reliability and schedule compression cited as reasons.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant cleared the 380-kilogram mail and six late bags in aft hold 5 after comparing total weight with three recent LMCs, without calculating the placement-specific index shift.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Decision point 2 contains the intended substitution mechanism: aggregate weight similarity was used as an easier proxy for the harder placement-specific index calculation under time scarcity.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant inferred that the rotation was running tail-heavy from the ramp report and two prior aft-trim events, then shifted cargo forward beyond what the current flight's own index required.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Decision point 3 contains the intended apophenia/correlation mechanism: a recurring causal pattern was inferred from two temporally adjacent events and used to override valid current-flight data.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant signed and released with a one-bag discrepancy after weighing delay risk against the possibility of a routine miscount; the discrepancy was later corrected without changing the W&B conclusion.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Decision point 4 is deliberately neutral and genuinely ambiguous. The participant made an explicit operational risk tradeoff, and either sign-off or a short hold was professionally defensible.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The participant recommended pulling the manual chart for irregular cargo and keeping the current flight's numbers separate from prior flights unless a shared cause is known, while remaining uncertain about the LMC issue.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a retrospective recommendation and uncertainty statement, not an additional hidden occurrence.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 1: accepting the automatically generated ALI for irregular machinery cargo without the available manual cross-check
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Bypassing an independent manual check on an automated output for an atypical case, using general system reliability and compressed schedule pressure as justification.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Automation bias is an established scholarly equivalent or shortened form of the hidden Automaticity or Automation Bias target.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures acceptance of a system-generated hold assignment for atypical cargo without the available manual verification, explicitly linking the choice to system reliability and time pressure.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is present in the raw interview, correctly attributed to the Participant, and directly supports the mechanism.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 2: clearing the aft-hold LMC using aggregate weight similarity instead of placement-specific index verification
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Replacing the harder placement-specific index or moment question with the easier proxy question of whether aggregate LMC weight resembles recent examples, with time scarcity contributing to the shortcut.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic is a distinct near-neighbor construct involving accessibility of examples. It is not an approved equivalent of substitution bias, even though the finding describes the correct proxy substitution.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures the defining distortion: total-weight similarity to recent LMCs was used instead of calculating the placement-specific index shift for aft hold 5, under time pressure.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: All quoted evidence is present in the raw interview, correctly attributed, and supports the weight-proxy mechanism.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Decision point 3: forward redistribution based on two preceding aft-trim events
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Inferring a causal recurring rotation-level pattern from two temporally adjacent but causally unrelated prior events and using it to override valid current-flight calculations, with time scarcity limiting further checking.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Illusory correlation is an established scholarly equivalent of the hidden correlation-bias construct in this context.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures inferring a meaningful rotation-level relationship from two prior events with different tails and unrelated causes, then overriding the current flight's valid index.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Two supporting quotes are valid, direct Participant quotations. A third quote is invalidly attributed because it combines an interviewer question with the Participant's answer, but the valid quotes independently establish the occurrence.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding is correctly localized and fully describes the substitution mechanism, but availability heuristic is not an approved equivalent label for substitution bias.

The candidate concerns a neutral and explicitly ambiguous sign-off tradeoff; no hidden instance remains unmatched, and its proposed normalization mechanism is not supported as a hidden bias occurrence.

candidates.details: The RAG system explicitly withheld identification because the interview supports an ordinary operational risk judgment rather than an affirmative bias-specific mechanism. Under the benchmark rule, however, the localized candidate still counts as a fourth-threshold detection and creates a segment-level false alarm.

high_only.detection_interpretation: Both high-confidence findings detect their positive segments; the moderate-confidence substitution-related finding is excluded, producing one miss and no false alarms.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: All three positive reasoning segments are detected with no segment-level false alarms.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: All three positive reasoning segments are detected with no segment-level false alarms.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: The candidate on the neutral final-sign-off segment adds one false alarm while leaving all positive-segment hits intact.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: The label is distinct, but the stated mechanism fully captures use of aggregate weight similarity as a proxy for the harder placement-specific index calculation.
The candidate proposes a possible normalization mechanism for a neutral, explicitly ambiguous sign-off decision; it does not overlap a hidden instance.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG output explicitly states that no retrieved corpus support was used and provides no corpus citations. This is internally consistent; retrieval fidelity is not scored.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Adding the moderate-confidence occurrence changes segment detection from 2/3 hits to 3/3 and changes mechanism-first instance F1 from 0.8000 to 1.0000, but strict instance F1 becomes 0.6667 because the added finding has the wrong label.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: No change; there are no low-confidence identified findings.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: Adding the candidate preserves all positive hits but adds one segment-level and mechanism-first instance-level false positive.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, all three positive segments are detected with no false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: Two of three hidden instances receive strict true positives. The substitution mechanism is correctly localized and fully described but assigned the near-neighbor label availability heuristic, producing one strict false positive and one false negative.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: All three hidden mechanisms receive mechanism-first true positives at high_and_moderate, with no false positives.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful abstention from identified status, but it still counts as a fourth-threshold false alarm because it localizes to the eligible neutral sign-off segment.
main_failure_modes: Near-neighbor mislabeling of substitution bias as availability heuristic
One invalid or misattributed evidence quotation in obs_003
Candidate-level speculation on the neutral final-sign-off episode
main_strengths: Correct localization of all three hidden bias mechanisms
Correct automation-bias and illusory-correlation detections using approved equivalent labels
Strong mechanism descriptions and valid supporting evidence for the substantive occurrences
Appropriate refusal to identify the ambiguous final sign-off as a definite bias
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has perfect segment detection at the recommended threshold and perfect mechanism-first instance identification, while strict label scoring exposes one taxonomy error. Candidate inclusion adds a false alarm without improving hidden-instance recall.
